statement: A record whose H1 is `# ADR-<digits> ...` ingests with provenance='authored'; a record whose H1 is `# Decision: ...` ingests with provenance='captured'. These are the only two record shapes REC-001 accepts, and they map to different provenance tiers.
note: Verified by running both fixtures through ingest.parse_adr + ingest.record_to_node on v0.8.3.
